title: Grandstream GWN7630LR Dual Band Wi-Fi Outdoor Access Point

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GWN7630LR is a powerful outdoor Wi-Fi access point featuring dual-band 4×4:4 MU-MIMO technology and up to 2.33Gbps wireless throughput. Designed for long-range deployments, it provides coverage of up to 300 meters and supports more than 250 concurrent users. With weatherproof construction, PoE/PoE+ support, detachable high-gain antennas, WPA3 security, and cloud-based management, the GWN7630LR is an ideal solution for enterprises, educational institutions, warehouses, resorts, and outdoor public Wi-Fi networks. Purchase the Grandstream GWN7630LR from D CORE at the best price in Bangladesh

Key Features


  • IEEE 802.11ac Wave-2 Wi-Fi technology
  • Dual-band 4×4:4 MU-MIMO architecture
  • Up to 2.33 Gbps aggregate wireless throughput
  • Supports 250+ concurrent Wi-Fi clients
  • Coverage range up to 300 meters
  • 2 × Gigabit Ethernet ports
  • IEEE 802.3af/802.3at PoE/PoE+ support
  • Weatherproof and heat-resistant outdoor design
  • WPA3 wireless security
  • Built-in controller for up to 50 local GWN access points
  • Cloud management via GDMS Networking and GWN Manager platforms
